desc:
🏁 RACE. CUSTOMIZE. DOMINATE.

Race through the streets, earn Cash, master wheelies, and build the ultimate scooter!

🏍️ FEATURES
🏁 Race other players and earn Cash
🛵 Perform wheelies, combos, and street stunts
🧰 Upgrade cylinders, exhausts, carburetors, body kits, and more
💨 Unlock faster bikes and create your own style
🏆 Compete and show off your setup
👮 Become a police officer and catch lawbreakers — applications are available in our community server (Limited time)
💎 Premium players earn 1.5× Cash

🎮 CONTROLS
🛵 Wheelie — Left Ctrl / L1
🔥 Start Engine — F / X
🧨 Fireworks — Left Click / Y
🏃 Sprint — Left Shift / L3
👁️ First Person — V / D-Pad Left

🎟️ CODES
BIKELIFENETHERLANDS
8MVISITS
350KMEMBERS
